## Introduction

DOI aP and wP vaccinated animals during their vaccination phase (baseline, day1, day3, and day8 of first dose). Naive animals during challenge (baseline, day3, day7, day14)

## Load data

### load count table and study design

```{r}
A.countData <- read.csv("counts.csv", header = TRUE)
B.studydesign <- read.csv("studydesign.csv", header = TRUE)

B.studydesign <- as.data.frame(B.studydesign)
rownames(B.studydesign) <- B.studydesign$label
A.countData <- as.data.frame(A.countData)
rownames(A.countData) <- A.countData$gene_id
A.countData <- A.countData[, -1]
A.countData <- A.countData[, rownames(B.studydesign)]


D.DGEList.countData <- DGEList(A.countData)

```

## Filtering and normalization

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hide"
#| warning: false

E.cpm.countData <- cpm(D.DGEList.countData) 
F.log2.cpm.countData <- cpm(D.DGEList.countData, log=TRUE)
F.log2.cpm.countData.df <- as_tibble(F.log2.cpm.countData, rownames = NA)
rownames_to_column(F.log2.cpm.countData.df)
F.log2.cpm.countData.df.pivot <- pivot_longer(F.log2.cpm.countData.df,
                                             cols = everything(),
                                             names_to = "samples",
                                             values_to = "expression")

ggplot(F.log2.cpm.countData.df.pivot) +
  aes(x=samples, y=expression, fill=samples) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = "median", 
               geom = "point", 
               shape = 95, 
               size = 10, 
               color = "black", 
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(y="log2 expression", x = "sample",
       title="Log2 Counts per Million (CPM)",
       subtitle="unfiltered non-normalized gene level",
       caption=paste0("produced on ", Sys.time())) +
  theme_bw()

rm(F.log2.cpm.countData.df, F.log2.cpm.countData.df.pivot, F.log2.cpm.countData)
```

### normalization

Using edgeR TMM method

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| results: "hide"
#| warning: false

J.DGEList.countData.filtered.norm <- calcNormFactors(H.DGEList.countData.filtered, method = "TMM")
K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm <- cpm(J.DGEList.countData.filtered.norm, log=TRUE)
K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm.df <- as_tibble(K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm, rownames = NA)
rownames_to_column(K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm.df)
K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm.df.pivot <- pivot_longer(K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm.df,
                                                            cols = everything(),
                                                            names_to = "samples",
                                                       values_to = "expression")

ggplot(K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm.df.pivot) +
  aes(x=samples, y=expression, fill=samples) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = "median", 
               geom = "point", 
               shape = 95, 
               size = 10, 
               color = "black", 
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(y="log2 expression", x = "sample",
       title="Log2 Counts per Million (CPM)",
       subtitle="filtered normalized (TMM) gene level",
       caption=paste0("produced on ", Sys.time())) +
  theme_bw()

rm(K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm.df.pivot, G.keepers.countData, E.cpm.countData, H.DGEList.countData.filtered)
```

## DGE
### model the mean-variance relationship and fit a linear model to data

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + batch + sex, data=B.studydesign)

v1 <- voomWithQualityWeights(J.DGEList.countData.filtered.norm, design, plot = TRUE)

corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(
  v1,
  design = design,
  block  = B.studydesign$animal
)
corfit$consensus.correlation
v2 <- voomWithQualityWeights(
  J.DGEList.countData.filtered.norm,
  design = design,
  block  = B.studydesign$animal,
  correlation = corfit$consensus.correlation,
  plot = TRUE
)
```

###PCA
```{r}
logCPM_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(
  K.log2.cpm.countData.filtered.norm,
  batch = B.studydesign$batch,
  covariates = model.matrix(~ sex, data=B.studydesign)[, -1]
) # also for WGCNA

time <- B.studydesign$time
time <- factor(time, levels = c("Baseline", "V1D1", "V1D3", "V1D8", "V1D14"))

treatment <- B.studydesign$treatment
treatment <- factor(treatment)

group <- B.studydesign$group
group <- factor(group)

L.pca.res.transcript <- prcomp(t(logCPM_corrected), scale.=F, retx=T)

ls(L.pca.res.transcript)
summary(L.pca.res.transcript)
screeplot(L.pca.res.transcript)
M.pc.var.transcript<-L.pca.res.transcript$sdev^2
N.pc.per.transcript<-round(M.pc.var.transcript/sum(M.pc.var.transcript)*100, 1)
N.pc.per.transcript

O.pca.res.transcript.df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = L.pca.res.transcript$x[,1],
  PC2 = L.pca.res.transcript$x[,2],
  sample = rownames(L.pca.res.transcript$x)
)
O.pca.res.transcript.df <- cbind(
  O.pca.res.transcript.df,
  B.studydesign[match(O.pca.res.transcript.df$sample, B.studydesign$label),
                c("treatment", "group", "time", "sex")]
)

O.pca.res.transcript.df$time <- factor(
  O.pca.res.transcript.df$time,
  levels = c("Baseline", "V1D1", "V1D3", "V1D8", "V1D14")
)
ggplot(O.pca.res.transcript.df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = time, shape = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (",N.pc.per.transcript[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (",N.pc.per.transcript[2], "%)")) +
  labs(title="PCA gene level") +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
W.fit.countData <- lmFit(
  v2,
  design,
  block = B.studydesign$animal,
  correlation = corfit$consensus.correlation
)

X.contrast.matrix <- makeContrasts(
  C1aP_V1D1 = groupaP_V1D1 - groupaP_Baseline,
  C2aP_V1D3 = groupaP_V1D3 - groupaP_Baseline,
  C3aP_V1D8 = groupaP_V1D8 - groupaP_Baseline,
  C4wP_V1D1 = groupwP_V1D1 - groupwP_Baseline,
  C5wP_V1D3 = groupwP_V1D3 - groupwP_Baseline,
  C6wP_V1D8 = groupwP_V1D8 - groupwP_Baseline,
  C7Baseline_aP_wP = groupwP_Baseline - groupaP_Baseline,
  C8V1D1_aP_wP = (groupwP_V1D1 - groupwP_Baseline) - (groupaP_V1D1 - groupaP_Baseline),
  C9V1D3_aP_wP = (groupwP_V1D3 - groupwP_Baseline) - (groupaP_V1D3 - groupaP_Baseline),
  C10V1D8_aP_wP = (groupwP_V1D8 - groupwP_Baseline) - (groupaP_V1D8 - groupaP_Baseline),
  C11WT_day3 = groupWT_day3 - groupWT_pre,
  C12WT_day7 = groupWT_day7 - groupWT_pre,
  C13WT_day14 = groupWT_day14 - groupWT_pre,
  C14Baseline_WT_aP = groupWT_pre - groupaP_Baseline,
  C15V1D3_WT_aP = (groupWT_day3 - groupWT_pre) - (groupaP_V1D3 - groupaP_Baseline),
  C16V1D8_WT_aP = (groupWT_day7 - groupWT_pre) - (groupaP_V1D8 - groupaP_Baseline),
  C17Baseline_WT_wP = groupWT_pre - groupwP_Baseline,
  C18V1D3_WT_wP = (groupWT_day3 - groupWT_pre) - (groupwP_V1D3 - groupwP_Baseline),
  C19V1D8_WT_wP = (groupWT_day7 - groupWT_pre) - (groupwP_V1D8 - groupwP_Baseline),
  levels=design)

Y.fits.countData <- contrasts.fit(W.fit.countData, X.contrast.matrix)
Z.ebFit.countData <- eBayes(Y.fits.countData)
plotSA(Z.ebFit.countData, main="Final model: Mean-variance trend")
```

### topTables and annotation

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Annotation
baboon.anno <- useMart(biomart = "ENSEMBL_MART_ENSEMBL",
                       # host = "https://may2024.archive.ensembl.org",
                       dataset = "panubis_gene_ensembl") #Olive baboon genes (Panubis1.0)
# baboon.filter <- listFilters(baboon.anno)
# attribute <- listAttributes(baboon.anno)
top_hits <- topTable(Z.ebFit.countData, adjust = "BH", coef = 1, number = 40000, sort.by = "logFC")
top_hits$gene_id <- rownames(top_hits)

ensembl_ids <- top_hits$gene_id
homolog_names <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name"), 
                       filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                       values = ensembl_ids,
                       mart = baboon.anno)

homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name[homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name == ""] <- homolog_names$ensembl_gene_id[homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name == ""]
duplicates <- duplicated(homolog_names$ensembl_gene_id)
summary(duplicates)
homolog_names_unique <- homolog_names %>%
  arrange(ensembl_gene_id, hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name) %>% # Sort by ensembl_gene_id and then alphabetically by associated_gene_name
  distinct(ensembl_gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)       # Keep the first occurrence of each ensembl_gene_id
duplicates <- duplicated(homolog_names_unique$ensembl_gene_id)
summary(duplicates)

for (i in 1:19) {
  top_hits <- topTable(Z.ebFit.countData, adjust = "BH", coef = i, number = 40000, sort.by = "logFC")
  top_hits$gene_id <- rownames(top_hits)
  filename <- paste0("DGEdose1", i, ".csv")
  write_csv(top_hits, filename)
  top_hits <- left_join(homolog_names_unique, top_hits, by = c("ensembl_gene_id" = "gene_id"))
  top_hits <- top_hits %>%
    dplyr::select(-ensembl_gene_id) %>%
    mutate(original_order = row_number()) %>%
    group_by(hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name) %>%
    filter(AveExpr == max(AveExpr)) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(original_order) %>%
    dplyr::select(-original_order)
  filename <- paste0("DGEdose1_anno", i, ".csv")
  write_csv(top_hits, filename)
}


```

### term2gene

```{r}
papio_go_slim <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "go_id", "goslim_goa_accession", "goslim_goa_description", "name_1006", "definition_1006", "go_linkage_type","namespace_1003"),
                       mart = baboon.anno)

gmt_list <- papio_go_slim %>%
  filter(go_id != "") %>%
  group_by(goslim_goa_accession, goslim_goa_description, go_id, name_1006, definition_1006, namespace_1003, go_linkage_type)

ensembl_ids <- gmt_list$ensembl_gene_id

homolog_names <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name"), 
                       filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                       values = ensembl_ids,
                       mart = baboon.anno)

homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name[homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name == ""] <- homolog_names$ensembl_gene_id[homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name == ""]
duplicates <- duplicated(homolog_names$ensembl_gene_id)
summary(duplicates)
homolog_names_unique <- homolog_names %>%
  arrange(ensembl_gene_id, hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name) %>% 
  distinct(ensembl_gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) 

gmt_list <- left_join(homolog_names_unique, gmt_list, by = c("ensembl_gene_id" = "ensembl_gene_id"))

cols <- c("hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name", "name_1006")
term2gene <- gmt_list[, cols, drop = FALSE]
colnames(term2gene) <- c("gene", "term")
term2gene <- term2gene[, c("term", "gene")]
term2gene <- term2gene[term2gene$term != "" & term2gene$gene != "", ]
term2gene <- unique(term2gene)

```

### GSEA

```{r}
for (i in 1:19) {
  ZA <- read_csv(
    paste0("DGEdose1_anno", i, ".csv")
  )

  gene_list <- ZA$logFC
  names(gene_list) <- ZA$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name
  gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

  gsea_result <- GSEA(
    geneList      = gene_list,
    TERM2GENE     = term2gene,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    exponent      = 1,
    minGSSize     = 5,
    maxGSSize     = 800,
    pvalueCutoff  = 1
  )

  gsea <- as.data.frame(gsea_result@result)

  out_file <- paste0(
    "gsea", i, ".csv"
  )
  
  write_csv(gsea, out_file)

}
```

## WGCNA
```{r}
ensembl_ids <- rownames(logCPM_corrected)
logCPM_corrected.df <- as_tibble(logCPM_corrected, rownames = "geneID")
homolog_names <- getBM(attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name"), 
                       filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                       values = ensembl_ids,
                       mart = baboon.anno)

homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name[homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name == ""] <- homolog_names$ensembl_gene_id[homolog_names$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name == ""]
duplicates <- duplicated(homolog_names$ensembl_gene_id)
summary(duplicates)
homolog_names_unique <- homolog_names %>%
  arrange(ensembl_gene_id, hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name) %>% # Sort by ensembl_gene_id and then alphabetically by associated_gene_name
  distinct(ensembl_gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)       # Keep the first occurrence of each ensembl_gene_id
duplicates <- duplicated(homolog_names_unique$ensembl_gene_id)
summary(duplicates)

logCPM_corrected.df <- left_join(homolog_names_unique, logCPM_corrected.df, by = c("ensembl_gene_id" = "geneID"))

logCPM_corrected.df <- logCPM_corrected.df %>% dplyr::select(-ensembl_gene_id)
logCPM_corrected.df$row_sum <- rowSums(logCPM_corrected.df[, -1])
logCPM_corrected.df <- logCPM_corrected.df %>%
  group_by(hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name) %>%
  filter(row_sum == max(row_sum)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%  # In case of ties, take the first one
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-row_sum)  # Remove the temporary row_sum column
logCPM_corrected.df <- as.data.frame(logCPM_corrected.df)
rownames(logCPM_corrected.df) <- logCPM_corrected.df[[1]]
logCPM_corrected.df <- logCPM_corrected.df[, -1]
```

```{r}
allowWGCNAThreads()
logCPM_corrected.mat <- as.matrix(logCPM_corrected.df)
vars <- rowVars(logCPM_corrected.mat)
keep_var <- vars > quantile(vars, 0.40)  # top 60% variance
logCPM_corrected.mat <- logCPM_corrected.mat[keep_var, ]
logCPM_corrected.mat.df <- as.data.frame(logCPM_corrected.mat)

t.wgcna <- t(logCPM_corrected.mat.df)
wgcna_design <- B.studydesign
# detect outliers if any
# sampleTree <- hclust(dist(t.wgcna), method = "average")
# plot(sampleTree, main = "Sample clustering", sub="", xlab="", cex.lab = 1.5)

# select power
power <- c(c(1:10), seq(from = 12, to = 50, by = 2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(t.wgcna,
                         powerVector = power,
                         networkType = "signed",
                         verbose = 5)
sft.data <- sft$fitIndices
a1 <- ggplot(sft.data, aes(Power, SFT.R.sq, label = Power)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color = 'red') +
  labs(x = 'Power', y = 'Scale free topology model fit, signed R^2') +
  theme_classic()

a2 <- ggplot(sft.data, aes(Power, mean.k., label = Power)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 0.1) +
  labs(x = 'Power', y = 'Mean Connectivity') +
  theme_classic()

plot_grid(a1, a2,
          labels = c('A', 'B'), label_size = 12, ncol = 1)

soft_power <- 5
# temp_cor <- cor
# cor <- WGCNA::cor
# memory estimate w.r.t blocksize
bwnet <- blockwiseModules(t.wgcna,
                          maxBlockSize = 20000,
                          TOMType = "signed",
                          power = soft_power,
                          numericLabels = TRUE,
                          # deepSplit = 4,      # your setting
                          minModuleSize = 20, # your setting
                          mergeCutHeight = 0.42, # your setting (no merging)
                          randomSeed = 1234,
                          verbose = 3)
# cor <- temp_cor
module_eigengenes <- bwnet$MEs
table(bwnet$colors)
custom_order1 <- c("ME0","ME1", "ME2", "ME3", "ME4", "ME5", "ME6", "ME7", "ME8", "ME9", "ME10", "ME11", "ME12")
module_eigengenes <- module_eigengenes[, custom_order1]
plotDendroAndColors(bwnet$dendrograms[[1]], cbind(bwnet$unmergedColors, bwnet$colors),
                    c("unmerged", "merged"),
                    dendroLabels = FALSE,
                    addGuide = TRUE,
                    hang= 0.03,
                    guideHang = 0.05)

ME.dissimilarity = 1-cor(module_eigengenes, use="complete") #Calculate eigengene dissimilarity
METree = hclust(as.dist(ME.dissimilarity), method = "average") #Clustering eigengenes 
par(mar = c(0,4,2,0)) #seting margin sizes
par(cex = 0.6);#scaling the graphic

plot(METree)
```

###enricher
```{r}
all_enrich_results <- list()
row_id <- 1

for (i in 0:12) {
  
  module_name <- as.character(i)
  
  if (!module_name %in% names(genes_by_module)) next
  
  module_genes <- genes_by_module[[module_name]]
  
  if (length(module_genes) == 0) next
  
  ego <- enricher(
    gene = module_genes,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    minGSSize = 5,
    maxGSSize = 800,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    TERM2GENE = term2gene
  )
  
  if (is.null(ego) || nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) == 0) next
  
  ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  
  ego_df <- ego_df %>%
    filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(module = module_name)
  
  if (nrow(ego_df) == 0) next
  
  all_enrich_results[[row_id]] <- ego_df
  row_id <- row_id + 1
}

combined_enrichment <- bind_rows(all_enrich_results)

```
